rows.claim: The old code used strptime with %W/%w, which is US-style week numbering (weeks start Sunday, week 1 starts on the first Sunday), not ISO 8601.
rows.evidence: The old code used %W, which in Python strptime is Monday-first week numbering (week 1 begins on the first Monday), not US/Sunday-first numbering (that is %U). The agent's description is therefore wrong. No tool output shows %W as Sunday-based; the transcript only shows it failing to parse 'W53' and returning wrong dates, which doesn't support the Sunday claim. It is not ISO 8601, but the 'US-style, Sunday' characterization is incorrect.
